==Description==
'''Crab Rave''' is an emote that could be obtained at level 19 of the premium [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] track. It was made by fybirr. The emote is looped and music can be heard while performing the emote. The player is unable to move while performing the emote or interact with it.

Once used, three [[Crab]]s will emerge from the ground, including a king [[Crab]], surround the player by dancing around them. Their character unable to move due to the crabs will begin shivering and covering their face out of fear.

It has a cost of {{BeachBalls|520}} or {{Robux|51}} to unlock it, with a total cost of {{BeachBalls|4,320}} or {{Robux|1,026}}. Prior to the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] individual skip cost fix, it had a total cost of {{Robux|1,116}}. This item also has had two other costs. First one was the cost before its 20% discount, which had a cost of {{Robux|64}} with a total cost of {{Robux|1,291}}. The second was the price prior to the [[Surf & Turf Battle Pass]] individual skip cost fix, where it had a total cost of {{Robux|1,116}}.

==Trivia==
*This emote is a reference to [https://knowyourmeme.com/memes/crab-rave Crab Rave], a 2018 meme originating from [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=LDU_Txk06tM a song of the same name] composed by Noisestorm.
*If the player uses the [[Snowball]] emote, cancels it, then uses '''Crab Rave''', and begins moving when the snowball would normally be thrown, this action allows movement during the emote. However, the player will slide significantly, drifting to the left or right.
**Additionally, if the player moves far enough away from the original position, the music heard will become quieter. This is because the music does not come from either the player or even the crabs, but from a third source that remains stationary.
